tar -xzf .stage6-work/node.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C .stage6-work/node
  export PATH=/src/.stage6-work/node/bin:$PATH COREPACK_HOME=/src/.stage6-work/corepack-home PNPM_HOME=/src/.stage6-work/pnpm-home
  corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
  chmod 0755 ./gradlew
  GRADLE_USER_HOME=/src/.stage6-work/gradle-home ./gradlew verifyGenerated :ji-standalone:runtimeTar --no-daemon
  bundle=$(find ji-java/products/ji-standalone/build/distributions -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "*linux-amd64-java21.tar.gz" -print -quit)
  test -n "$bundle"
